hint.description: An extra hint to understand the violation

message.description: The message associated with the violation

payload.description: The serialized payload of the violation

propertyPath.description: The property path of the violation

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem. It may or may not yield further information if dereferenced.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem.

type.description: A URI reference that identifies the problem type

parameters.description: true: the returns a credit note is owed for now (the credit issuer's queue); false: the others. PC-9's third exception: membership is served to every sales_return.view holder.
parameters.name: creditable

parameters.description: true: the returns that lowered an invoice with no credit note (owner ruling Q-L (a′)) — a list to reconcile against goods actually received.
parameters.name: deducts

parameters.description: true: returns that would be creditable but whose invoice is paid. Served only to an invoice.view holder; refused as a parameter error for anyone else.
parameters.name: credit_blocked_by_payment

parameters.description: true: returns on an order line that already carries a credit without a return, waiting for a decision (already credited, or, by an owner, different goods) before they can be credited. Served only to an invoice.view holder; refused as a parameter error for anyone else.
parameters.name: adjustment_decision_owed

parameters.description: same: returns carrying a live "already credited" decision — the owner's review list. Served only to an invoice.view holder.
parameters.name: adjustment_decided

parameters.description: With adjustment_decided=same: only decisions recorded at or after this RFC 3339 instant. A decision's time is its transaction's start, so start each review a little before the last one. Served only to an invoice.view holder.
parameters.name: decided_since
